# PakPedia

> Pakistan’s all-in-one information directory for verified schools, hospitals, live gold & silver rates, newspapers and national news.

PakPedia helps Pakistani citizens and visitors quickly find reliable information about educational institutions, healthcare facilities, precious metal rates and current affairs.

## Key pages

- [Home](https://pakpediaonline.vercel.app/): Main directory search, live rates and latest news
- [Hospitals](https://pakpediaonline.vercel.app/hospitals): Verified hospital listings across Pakistan
- [Schools](https://pakpediaonline.vercel.app/schools): Top schools with ratings and contact details
- [Gold & Silver Rates](https://pakpediaonline.vercel.app/rates): Live indicative rates in Pakistan
- [News](https://pakpediaonline.vercel.app/news): Latest Pakistan headlines and newspaper links
- [FAQ](https://pakpediaonline.vercel.app/faq): Frequently asked questions
- [About](https://pakpediaonline.vercel.app/about): Mission and commitments
- [Contact](https://pakpediaonline.vercel.app/contact): Get in touch or suggest a listing
